content: The target has a direct conjugation-action proof. Let G act on itself by conjugation. Singleton orbits are exactly central elements. For x not central, its orbit has size [G:C_G(x)], which divides |G|=p^n and exceeds 1, hence is divisible by p. Partitioning G into singleton and nonsingleton orbits gives |G| congruent to |Z(G)| modulo p; since p divides |G|, p divides |Z(G)|. As the identity is central and p>=2, the center has a nonidentity element.
